content: चूर्णकः [चूर्ण स्वार्थे क] .²1 Grain fried and pounded. .²2 A species of silk-cotton tree (शाल्मलीविशेष); अङ्कोलाश्च कुरण्टाश्च चूर्णकाः पारिभद्रकाः <ls>Rām. 4. 1. 80</ls>. .{@-कम्@} .²1 A fragrant powder. .²2 A style of prose-composition which is easy, does not contain hard letters, and has very few compounds; अकठोराक्षरं स्वल्पसमासं चूर्णकं विदुः <ls>Chand. M. 6</ls>. .²3 Explaining in prose the purport of a foregoing verse.
